description: Evidenca lokalnih cest in javnih poti v Občini Osilnica is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA OSILNICA. Local roads and public paths in the area of the Municipality of Osilnica. The record contains the code of the local road or public path and the section, the location, where the road or path runs and its length. Municipal roads are categorized into local roads (LC), public paths (JP) and municipal cycling paths. Coverage: OBČINA OSILNICA. The portal shows the English title as "Register of local roads and public paths in the Municipality of Osilnica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA OSILNICA. Its keywords include odsek, javna pot, občinska cesta, lokalna cesta. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML, CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
